body:
## Symptom

On pdca-pdca, the size backstop's rounds rule fired in 4 of the 6 cycles frozen between 2026-08-06 and 2026-08-09 (issues 453, 456, 457, 468), each at exactly rounds=2/threshold 2, and each firing was noise: the slices were modest (25–47 KB, 2–6 files — nowhere near the patch thresholds) and merged at sign-off without a split.

issue_453 §10 names the cause for its two rounds: one lost to a broken environment (a missing `copier` in the verifier), one spent on findings that are **permanently human** — T4 contribution artifacts withheld from the reviewer by design, and validation fitness-to-purpose, which is human-only by the sign-off contract. Neither round was an implementation-shaped finding, which is the thing the rounds rule exists to detect (76% precision that a third round follows was calibrated against churn, not against structurally-recurring human classes).

## Gap

#446 (merged) fixed the first half: a round whose *sole* recorded driver was an environment fault is no longer charged. But it is deliberately narrow — "a round with a real failure, a real review finding, or any ambiguous/missing evidence still counts." A NEEDS-HUMAN item of a permanently-human class *is* a real review finding, so a round whose only drivers are such classes still counts against the slice. On an instance where those classes recur structurally every cycle (e.g. while the reviewer cannot reach the T4 oracle), every bundle that iterates once for any reason arrives at threshold with one round of pure human-class noise already charged.

## Suggested direction

When reading an archived round's evidence (the #446 machinery already opens it), also discount a round whose only recorded drivers are findings of classes that no rebuild can change — at minimum the always-human validation row, and rows whose result is `deferred`/withheld-by-design. Same safety posture as #446: any ambiguity or any builder-actionable finding keeps the round counted, so the backstop can only over-warn less, never silently under-warn.

## Instance-side workaround (in place)

pdca-pdca loosened its thresholds at the 2026-08-09 Act review (`[driver.size_signal] rounds=3, patch_kb=125, patch_files=25`, ~25% per the human's 20–30%-over-target calibration) and will re-calibrate with `scripts/size-calibrate` once a release carrying #446 is consumed. That retune masks the noise; this issue is the cause.

Evidence: pdca-pdca `results/issue_453/SUMMARY.md` §10, and the four `size-signal.json` records of the wave (rounds=2 in all four). Routed from the 2026-08-09 Act review (process/act-log.md).
title: size-signal: rounds driven only by permanently-human finding classes still count against the slice — the backstop fires on noise #446 doesn't discount
